in_sanskrit.name: नियम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'ni' meaning to fix, and 'yam' meaning rule, regulation, law, discipline. It refers to a rule, regulation, or law that is set and must be followed.

in_hindi.name: नियम
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, 'नियम' translates to 'rule, regulation, law'.

in_tamil.name: நியமம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, 'நியமம்' translates to 'rule, regulation, law'. It is derived from the Tamil words 'நிற்கை' meaning to fix, and 'நியாமம்' meaning law.

in_telugu.name: నియమ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, 'నియమ' translates to 'rule, regulation, law'. It is derived from the Telugu word 'నీయమ' meaning law.

in_marathi.name: Niyam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niyam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niyam comes from the Sanskrit word ‘niyamah’ which means ‘rule’, ‘law’, or ‘duty’. It is also associated with the concept of ‘self-discipline’ and ‘self-control’. In Hindu mythology, Niyam is considered a virtue and a necessary aspect of living a righteous life.
